cards.text: Friend, this is John, God's servant, telling what he's been shown (Revelation 1:1). The seventh angel just sounded his trumpet (Revelation 11:15), and now a great sign appears in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, with the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head. And I thought MY chef's hat was a big look.

cards.question: This woman clothed in the sun has more going on than the shine. What's happening to her?

answers.text: She's leading an army of angels

cards.question: The woman is crying out in the pain of giving birth. Then a second sign appears in heaven. What is it?

cards.text: This dragon has seven heads, ten horns and seven royal crowns on his heads. SEVEN heads, and I've got one that can't even remember where I set the timer.

cards.question: The dragon's tail sweeps every last star out of the sky.

cards.text: His tail sweeps a third of the stars from the sky and hurls them to the earth. Then the dragon stands right in front of the woman, who's about to give birth.

cards.question: Why is the huge red dragon standing in front of the woman who's about to give birth?

answers.text: To devour her child as soon as it's born
To snatch the crown off her head
To steal the moon from under her feet

cards.text: Then she gives birth to a son, a male child, “who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” And baker, that dragon is standing right there.

cards.question: The dragon gets to the woman's newborn son before anyone can stop him.
Her son is caught up to God and to His throne. Then the woman flees into the ___, to a place God had prepared for her.

cards.text: There she'll be nourished for 1,260 days.
Then a war breaks out in heaven. Michael the archangel (Jude 1:9) and his angels fight against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fight back.

cards.question: In the war in heaven, the dragon isn't strong enough to win.

cards.text: No place is found in heaven anymore for him and his angels. EVICTED, baker, and I thought getting slid to the back of a junk drawer was a demotion.

cards.question: The great dragon is hurled down, and now John tells us exactly who this dragon is. Who is he?

answers.text: The ancient serpent called the devil

cards.text: He's also called Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He's hurled to the earth, and his angels go down with him.
Then John hears a loud voice in heaven. It says the salvation, the power and the kingdom of our God have come, and the authority of His Christ, right NOW.

cards.question: The loud voice in heaven says the salvation, the power and the kingdom of our God have come now. Why now?

answers.text: The accuser of our brothers is thrown down
The woman has come back from the wilderness
The dragon has surrendered his crowns

cards.text: He's the one who accuses our brothers day and night before our God. Day AND night, baker, that's the guy in the group chat who brings up your one mistake at sunrise AND at midnight.

cards.question: The voice says the brothers have conquered the accuser. How did they do it?

answers.text: By the blood of the Lamb and their testimony
By the strength of their hands and their courage
By the wisdom of the elders and their prayers

cards.text: And they didn't love their lives so much that they'd shy away from death. That one's heavy, friend, and I don't want to rush past it.

cards.question: Since the accuser has been thrown down, the voice calls on the heavens and everyone who dwells in them to ___.
The voice says the devil has come down to the earth and the sea with great fury.

cards.text: And the devil knows he has only a short time. Then, when the dragon sees he's been thrown to the earth, he goes after somebody.

cards.question: Once he's thrown to the earth, the dragon pursues the woman who gave birth to the son.
The dragon is coming after the woman. How does she get away?

answers.text: She's given two wings of a great eagle
She hides in a cave beside the sea
An angel carries her off on a cloud

cards.text: She flies to her place in the wilderness, where she's nourished for a time, and times, and half a time. The dragon is chasing somebody with EAGLE WINGS, baker, and I once lost a race to a chocolate chip rolling off the counter.
So the serpent tries something else. From his mouth he spews water like a river, to sweep her away in the torrent.

cards.question: Water like a river is rushing from the serpent's mouth toward the woman. What stops it?

answers.text: The earth opens up and swallows it
The sun dries it all up

cards.question: Enraged at the woman, the dragon goes back up to heaven to fight Michael again.

cards.text: Instead, the dragon goes to make war with the rest of her children. They're the ones who keep the commandments of God and hold to the testimony of Jesus.
Then the dragon stands on the shore of the sea. I'm hitting pause on the timer right here, baker, because this vision still has more coming.
